Dona JULIA JUANICO, "del propio estado y vecindad"

column1: # Until today the parentage of Luis Lerena Lenguas rested on the FamilySearch Tree and Geneanet -
# user-submitted, uncited, SECONDARY. This act states it: he is the legitimate son of DON LUIS and
# DONA JUSTINIANA LENGUAS. The join at the heart of the Montevideo trunk is now PRIMARY.
# It also names Julia Juanico's parents for the first time: Dr Don CANDIDO JUANICO and Dona JULIANA
# GONZALEZ. Candido Juanico - "abogado, magistrado, legislador y hombre politico", son of Francisco
# Juanico and Juliana Texeira - stood as a witness at his daughter's wedding. Published genealogy has
# him marrying SIXTA LENGUAS GONZALEZ in 1857; Julia is therefore a daughter of an earlier marriage,
# to Juliana Gonzalez. That is inference from the dates and is marked as such.
# And the date fits: married 19 December 1864, first child born at Rosario 8 October 1865.
